label: Exact shared strict-order test for existential production
summary: On a fixed exercise profile the required bearer and product edges have a common transitive irreflexive extension exactly when they have no nonempty finite closed walk. The acyclic graph therefore supports the existing exclusion and its diagonal CAUSE_4 route. Two separate strict orders can coexist with self-production and an irreflexive, nontransitive union. A four-edge cycle through two distinct producers obstructs the common order even without direct self-production. Actual enabling power supports bearer co-actuality. Independent availability of that actuality and genuinely supplying the product's being favor strict priority in the same existential reading. Strictness and composition are prima facie commitments for that interpretation. PRIOR_1 and PRIOR_5 do not supply the mixed-token assignments. Smith's simultaneous mutual origination is the live challenge to the embeddings. Spinoza's existence through essence and holistic constitutive explanation require separate assessment. See docs/notes/unique-feedback-explanation-311.md#can-bearer-and-production-priority-share-one-strict-order-2026-11-26.
blocker: For application, justify the two embeddings in one independently defended strict existential order or give a simultaneous-origin account supplying the actual powers and identity-preserving cycle. For the whole-bearer case justify the part-to-whole exercise and coming-to-be-to-being bridges. No philosophical premise is established by the extension criterion.
